messages:
kate: Quick announcement — I pushed a docs preview for Structured Output Contracts and a companion SDK validation flag. Preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/structured-output (staging only)

jessica: Nice. Is this opt-in or the new default?

kate: Opt-in for now. SDK flag is --validate-output / Client(validate_output=True). We want teams to try it before we consider a default.

ryan: Will there be automatic fixes for existing prompts that return unstructured text?

kate: No auto-fixes. We provide a compatibility shim that emits warnings and a linter rule. Shim tries to coerce simple cases (e.g., top-level JSON missing) but we won't mutate user text.

maria: Can you paste the quick example?

kate: Sure:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'], validate_output=True)
resp = client.generate(
  model='redwood-1.1',
  prompt='Give me a JSON object: {"name":..., "age":...}',
  output_schema={"type": "object", "required": ["name"]}
)
# resp.output is validated, raises SchemaError on mismatch
```

jessica: How does this interact with function/tool-calls?

kate: We validate either the function payload or the structured content depending on call style. Docs have a decision matrix. Link in the preview.

tom: Any perf impact? Token-level validation seems expensive.

kate: We run validation post-generation by default. For high-throughput paths there's a streaming validation mode (best-effort) — we note perf tradeoffs in the docs.

ryan: Who owns the GA timeline?

kate: Product + Eng-ML. Target GA: 6 weeks if no major backcompat issues. We'll run a limited beta with a few customers first.

jessica: Do we need a release note and marketing blurb?

kate: Yes — small release note + docs callout. I'll file a PR for release notes after we finalize the beta checklist.

docs-bot: docs-staging deploy succeeded — 1718214680 — branch: docs/structured-output-preview :rocket:

maria: Should we add opt-in via Console toggles for Dedicated/Private?

kate: Good call. I'll sync with infra to add a Console toggle and a per-route config so customers can enable per-app.

tom: Also recommend a sample eval prompt set to catch common mismatch patterns.

ryan: I'll add a few cases to the evals repo tomorrow.

jessica: OK — thanks. I'll loop in solutions-eng for beta invites. :thumbsup:

kate: Thanks everyone. Feedback welcome on the preview page; I'll keep the thread updated with GA checklist and beta list.
